map.name: Durnath
map.setting: a castle town with a garrison
map.trouble: The renegade Wizard Ostrigan holds the Black Spire north of Durnath, and his Imps and golems raid the land around the castle.

guard_bark.specifics: Torbek at the north gate of Durnath, where the road runs toward Ostrigan's Black Spire.

first.speaker: Torbek
first.text: Greetings, stranger! Watch the sky on the north road. The Imps have been dropping on travelers all week.

later.speaker: Torbek
later.text: Durnath owes you, brave Adventurer. Thank you.

bounty_offer.specifics: Fennick, a fussy old stargazer, wants the Giant Wasps' nest cleared out of his observatory east of town.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Oh, not again! Every night the same thing! I climb up to look at the stars and I come back down stung all over!

Giant Wasps have nested in my observatory east of here. My charts are ruined and my lenses are filthy, and Lord Tavrin's soldiers won't lift a finger. They say they are too busy watching for Ostrigan. Would you clear out those Wasps for me? I will pay you well.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Still here?! Those Wasps won't leave on their own, you know!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: No more buzzing! Listen! Not a single Wasp! Oh, thank you, thank you! Here is your reward, 100 gold pieces, as promised.

journal.text: Destroy the Wasp nest in Fennick's observatory.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Ilsabet, the castle healer, orders the player to get back her Staff of Mending from the Imps who stole it.

offer.speaker: Ilsabet
offer.text: And out the window they went, with my Staff of Mending! Imps! Filthy giggling Imps! They flew off toward the old quarry west of town. Go and get my staff back before they break it!

refusal.speaker: Ilsabet
refusal.text: Then what good are you? Out of my way!

reminder.speaker: Ilsabet
reminder.text: Well? Where's my staff? Go on, get moving!

completion.speaker: Ilsabet
completion.text: My staff! My staff! Oh, bless you, kind sir! Here, take this key. It opens the castle storeroom. Take whatever you need.

after.speaker: Ilsabet
after.text: Lord Tavrin was asking for you. He's waiting in the great hall of the keep.

journal.text: Recover Ilsabet's Staff of Mending from the Imps.

journal_done.text: Go to the keep and speak with Lord Tavrin.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Durnath: gossip about Lord Tavrin, a brush-off from a soldier, a complaint about the town's own folly.

rumour1.speaker: Nessa
rumour1.text: Lord Tavrin is up in the keep, waiting on somebody. He's been up there for a month! If you ask me, he's scared stiff of Ostrigan.

rumour3.speaker: Pibb
rumour3.text: We let that Wizard live up on the hill for years and nobody ever asked what he was doing up there. Not once! Now look at us.

shop_greeting.specifics: Brumbo of the Black Boar inn, Hulgar of the castle armory, Zelpha the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Brumbo
inn.text: Welcome to the Black Boar! A bed's only 10 gold, and I throw in the fleas fer free! Har, har, har!

arms.speaker: Hulgar
arms.text: Welcome to the Armory of Castle Durnath. Arms and armor for the loyal subjects of Lord Tavrin.

magic.speaker: Zelpha
magic.text: Hmph. Don't touch anything. Buy something or leave.

two_givers.specifics: Lady Orwenna orders the player to find the lost Horn of Durnath; Dobbs, a drunk soldier at the Black Boar, bets the player won't come back from the bell tower with it.

offer_a.speaker: Orwenna
offer_a.text: Aaah! Oh! Oh, it's only you. Thank goodness, I thought one of those Imps had gotten in again! Now you listen to me, because nobody in this castle ever listens to me, not my husband and not the guards and certainly not that drunken innkeeper, the Horn of Durnath is gone, the great silver horn that calls the garrison to the walls, and if Ostrigan comes in the night and nobody blows it then nobody wakes up and we will all be murdered in our beds, every one of us, the soldiers and the cooks and the little children too, and all because some fool left it lying around after the feast instead of putting it back where it belongs! Find the Horn of Durnath and bring it to me at once!

offer_b.speaker: Dobbs
offer_b.text: Heh, heh. Looking for her Ladyship's horn, are you? It's up in the old bell tower. The Ghosts took it up there, everybody knows that. I'll bet you 50 gold you don't come back down alive. Go on, shake on it!

outcome_a.speaker: Orwenna
outcome_a.text: The Horn! Oh, you found it! Here, take my husband's pass. The guards at the north gate will let you through now.

outcome_b.speaker: Dobbs
outcome_b.text: Well, look at that. You came back. Alright, alright, I lost. Here's your 50 gold.

journal_a.text: Find the Horn of Durnath for Lady Orwenna.

journal_b.text: Bring the Horn down from the bell tower to win Dobbs' bet.

rescue.specifics: Jasko, a peddler, bargains the key to the old sewer gate for his sister Mila, dragged into the catacombs by Zombies; she is found dying.

plea.speaker: Jasko
plea.text: Help! Help! The Zombies took my sister! They dragged Mila down into the catacombs! Look, friend, I'm a businessman, not a hero. So here's my offer. You bring her back and I give you the key to the old sewer gate. Nobody else in Durnath has one.

reminder.speaker: Jasko
reminder.text: Please hurry! Mila can't last long down there!

found.speaker: Mila
found.text: Is someone there? Jasko? I can't see... Please, I'm so cold...

following.speaker: Mila
following.text: Leave me here. I can't go on.

completion.speaker: Jasko
completion.text: Where's Mila? She didn't make it? Oh.... My poor sister. Here, take the key. I don't care about it any more.

journal.text: Find Jasko's sister Mila in the catacombs.

main_opening.specifics: Pibb points the player to Lord Tavrin in the keep; Tavrin sends him north against the renegade Wizard Ostrigan at the Black Spire.

herald.speaker: Pibb
herald.text: You're the one Ruvane sent? Lord Tavrin is waiting for you in the great hall of the keep.

opening.speaker: Tavrin
opening.text:
Grim news, lad. Very grim. My scouts came back from the Black Spire last night. Not all of them. Ostrigan has woken the stone golems under the Spire, and his Imps fly over our walls whenever they please.

Ruvane tells me you are the one for this. Go north to the Black Spire. Find Ostrigan and put an end to him. Get what you need in town before you go, and don't waste any time.

reminder.speaker: Tavrin
reminder.text: Those Imps get bolder every night.

journal.text: Go to the Black Spire and stop the Wizard Ostrigan.
